findings.evidence: Deleted file read "the homogeneous pieces of the Clifford degree filtration" / "the Clifford associated graded algebra" / "the quotient class of the Clifford unit"; the new text is the same sentence with the one word swapped. There is no object called a "filtered degree filtration" or a "filtered unit".
findings.fix: Say "the word filtration generated by `f`", "the associated graded algebra of the word filtration", "induced by multiplication in `A`", and "the quotient class of `(1 : A)` in degree zero".
findings.issue: Docstrings copied from the deleted Clifford file with "Clifford" mechanically replaced by "filtered", producing phrases that name nothing: line 110 `associatedGraded` "the homogeneous pieces of the filtered degree filtration"; line 160 `gradedMul` "the filtered associated graded algebra"; line 168 `gradedMul_apply_mk` "induced by filtered multiplication"; lines 223 and 229 `gradedOne_def`/`gradedOne_mk` "the quotient class of the filtered unit"; line 32 in the module docstring "induced by filtered multiplication".

findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:112-113 "the shared API is in `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/Basic.lean`"; `GradedPiece`/`gradedMul`/`associatedGraded` are defined in WordFiltration/AssociatedGraded.lean:107,160,110, and Basic.lean contains no graded construction.
findings.fix: Name the file explicitly: "so that the generic construction of `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/AssociatedGraded.lean` applies".
findings.issue: The added paragraph says "the generic associated-graded construction of that file", where "that file" is `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/Basic.lean` named in the preceding sentence; the associated-graded construction lives in `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/AssociatedGraded.lean`.

findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:193-195 vs. the notes added at lines 112, 134, 141, 163, 171, 179; PBW.lean:227 passes `FiltrationGradedPiece Q` to `DirectSum.toAlgebra` while lines 152/163 use `gradedMul (ι Q)` on the same elements.
findings.fix: Add "This is `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.GradedPiece` specialized to `ι Q`; the shared API is in `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/AssociatedGraded.lean`."
findings.issue: `FiltrationGradedPiece` is the only Clifford wrapper in this file whose docstring was not updated to identify it with its generic counterpart, although it is now reducibly the same type as `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.GradedPiece (ι Q)`, and PBW.lean uses the two names interchangeably.

findings.evidence: AssociatedGraded.lean:27-35 lists only `associatedGraded`, `gradedMul`, `gradedOne`, `gradedAlgebraMap₀`; `GradedPiece` is defined at line 107 and `previousRestricted` at line 82.
findings.fix: Add bullets for `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.GradedPiece f k` (the degree-`k` successive quotient) and `previousRestricted`, as `CliffordAlgebra.FiltrationGradedPiece` is listed in Filtration.lean's module docstring.
findings.issue: The "Main definitions" list omits `GradedPiece` and `previousRestricted`, the public abbreviations every declaration in the file is stated on; the `associatedGraded` bullet already refers to `GradedPiece f k` without introducing it.

summary: Every public declaration is documented, but several docstrings in the new generic file are unadapted copies of the deleted Clifford file ("the filtered degree filtration", "the filtered unit"), the `filtration` docstring points readers at the wrong file for the associated-graded construction, and the link between `FiltrationGradedPiece` and the generic `GradedPiece` is undocumented.
